1	import 'package:fpdart/fpdart.dart';
2	
3	import '../../../../core/failure/failure.dart';
4	
5	/// Story 2.4's one DI-singleton access point for the account's
6	/// `biometricEnabled` preference — mirrors `features/vault/domain/
7	/// repositories/vault_repository.dart`'s stream-plus-sync-getter shape
8	/// (AD-14), except the underlying source of truth is server-side (`PATCH
9	/// /account/settings`), not on-device.
10	///
11	/// [currentBiometricEnabled] is the single source both
12	/// `core/navigation/app_router.dart` (feeding `VaultLockScreen`'s
13	/// `attemptBiometricFirst`) and the Configurações toggle read — never a
14	/// second, independently-tracked copy of the same boolean.
15	abstract class AccountSettingsRepository {
16	  /// The exact [Failure.message] [setBiometricEnabled] returns when a call
17	  /// is discarded for being superseded by a newer one (the generation
18	  /// guard, `AccountSettingsRepositoryImpl._generation`) — an internal
19	  /// control-flow signal, not a real error, since the winning call already
20	  /// settled the value correctly by the time this one resolves.
21	  /// `AccountSettingsCubit` recognizes this exact string to suppress it
22	  /// from the UI rather than showing a raw, English, internal message.
23	  static const supersededMessage = 'Superseded by a newer preference update';
24	
25	  /// Broadcast stream of the current `biometricEnabled` preference. Like
26	  /// `VaultRepository.statusStream`, this always has a value from the
27	  /// moment the repository is constructed (`true`) — a late subscriber
28	  /// still immediately replays that cached value.
29	  Stream<bool> get biometricEnabledStream;
30	
31	  /// The last value emitted on [biometricEnabledStream], read
32	  /// synchronously — starts `true` (never `null`) so a cold boot before
33	  /// [fetchBiometricEnabled] resolves still degrades to "try biometric
34	  /// first" (Design Notes), never silent PIN-only.
35	  bool get currentBiometricEnabled;
36	
37	  /// Boot-time read: `PATCH /account/settings` called with `{}` — no GET
38	  /// endpoint exists for this resource (Boundaries). A successful response
39	  /// updates [currentBiometricEnabled]/[biometricEnabledStream] to the
40	  /// server's value; any [Failure] is swallowed (fire-and-forget, like
41	  /// `SessionRepository.restoreSession()`) and leaves
42	  /// [currentBiometricEnabled] exactly as it was.
43	  Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> fetchBiometricEnabled();
44	
45	  /// Story 2.4's optimistic toggle: [currentBiometricEnabled]/
46	  /// [biometricEnabledStream] flip to [enabled] immediately, before the
47	  /// `PATCH {"biometricEnabled": enabled}` call even starts (RNF01,
48	  /// <100ms) — then, on failure, revert back to the prior value and
49	  /// return `Left` so the caller can surface the `Failure`'s message. A
50	  /// successful PATCH leaves the optimistic value in place and returns
51	  /// `Right(unit)`.
52	  Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> setBiometricEnabled(bool enabled);
53	
54	  /// spec-8-3 — the profile name shown on Configurações, read by
55	  /// `AccountSettingsCubit` at construction (Boundaries: "Cubit reads
56	  /// displayName/email from the repository at construction"). Starts `''`
57	  /// (Boundaries: "default ''") and is set only from
58	  /// [fetchBiometricEnabled]'s own success branch (piggybacking on that
59	  /// call's response, Boundaries: "no new network call") or, once set,
60	  /// from a successful [setDisplayName].
61	  String get currentDisplayName;
62	
63	  /// spec-8-3 — the account's e-mail, read the same way as
64	  /// [currentDisplayName]; never written by this repository ("email is
65	  /// rejected" per the contract's own `PATCH /account/settings` summary).
66	  String get currentEmail;
67	
68	  /// spec-8-3 — writes the profile's `displayName` via
69	  /// `PATCH {"displayName": name}`. Not optimistic (Boundaries): unlike
70	  /// [setBiometricEnabled], [currentDisplayName] only changes once this
71	  /// call's PATCH actually succeeds. Guarded by its own generation counter,
72	  /// same shape as [setBiometricEnabled]'s own `_generation` guard but kept
73	  /// separate (Boundaries) — a call superseded by a newer overlapping one
74	  /// returns `Left(Failure.malformedResponse(message: supersededMessage))`
75	  /// without touching [currentDisplayName].
76	  Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> setDisplayName(String name);
77	
78	  /// Releases the underlying stream resource. Wired as `get_it`'s
79	  /// `dispose:` callback on registration, same rationale as
80	  /// `VaultRepository.dispose()`/`SessionRepository.dispose()`.
81	  Future<void> dispose();
82	}

17	/// Tela 6 — Configurações, Story 2.4's real build (Acceptance Criteria:
18	/// "shows only the biometric toggle — minimal, Epic 8 extends it, never
19	/// rebuilds it") extended by spec-8-1 with the "Sua evolução" chart
20	/// section below the toggle, and by spec-8-2 with its independent AI
21	/// narrative fetch. Replaces the former `ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen`.
22	class AccountSettingsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
23	  const AccountSettingsScreen({
24	    required this.cubit,
25	    required this.dashboardCubit,
26	    required this.narrativeCubit,
27	    super.key,
28	  });
29	
30	  final AccountSettingsCubit cubit;
31	
32	  /// spec-8-1 — the "Sua evolução" chart section's own cubit, a DI
33	  /// `lazySingleton` like [cubit] (Code Map); this `StatefulWidget` never
34	  /// closes it either, same rationale [cubit]'s own doc already gives.
35	  final DashboardCubit dashboardCubit;
36	
37	  /// spec-8-2 — the chart section's own independent AI narrative fetch, a
38	  /// second DI `lazySingleton` like [dashboardCubit] above (Boundaries:
39	  /// "two independent fetches fired in parallel, neither awaiting the
40	  /// other").
41	  final DashboardNarrativeCubit narrativeCubit;
42	
43	  @override
44	  State<AccountSettingsScreen> createState() => _AccountSettingsScreenState();
45	}
46	
47	class _AccountSettingsScreenState extends State<AccountSettingsScreen> {
48	  /// spec-8-3 — the inline name field's own controller. Its text is kept
49	  /// in sync with `AccountSettingsState.nameDraft` only when entering edit
50	  /// mode (the `BlocListener` below); while editing, the field's own
51	  /// `onChanged` is this screen's single source for both the controller's
52	  /// displayed text and the cubit's `nameDraft`.
53	  late final TextEditingController _nameController;
54	
55	  /// Review finding (code review): tracks whether the narrative-
56	  /// unavailable announcement has already fired for the current
57	  /// `totalCount > 30` streak, across `DashboardCubit.load()`'s own
58	  /// `ResourceLoading` emissions — `load()` always emits `ResourceLoading`
59	  /// before `ResourceData` (`dashboard_cubit.dart`), so comparing only
60	  /// against the immediately-previous emitted state (the original
61	  /// `listenWhen` approach) could never actually suppress a repeat
62	  /// announcement on a `confirmedWrites`-triggered reload: the state right
63	  /// before the next qualifying `ResourceData` is always `ResourceLoading`,
64	  /// never a qualifying `ResourceData`, so the old guard was true again
65	  /// every time. Reset only on an explicit `ResourceData` crossing back to
66	  /// `totalCount <= 30` — `ResourceLoading`/`ResourceError` emissions leave
67	  /// it untouched.
68	  bool _dashboardOverflowAnnounced = false;
69	
70	  @override
71	  void initState() {
72	    super.initState();
73	    // Review finding: `widget.cubit` is a DI singleton that outlives this
74	    // `State` — if it's already mid-edit on mount (e.g. the user left
75	    // Configurações via the back arrow, which never calls
76	    // `cancelEditingName`, then reopened it), a fresh, empty controller
77	    // would otherwise desync from the retained `nameDraft`: the field
78	    // shows blank while `confirmEditingName()` would silently save the
79	    // old, invisible draft.
80	    final cubitState = widget.cubit.state;
81	    _nameController = TextEditingController(
82	      text: cubitState.isEditingName ? cubitState.nameDraft : '',
83	    );
84	    if (cubitState.isEditingName) {
85	      _nameController.selection = TextSelection.collapsed(
86	        offset: _nameController.text.length,
87	      );
88	    }
89	    // Review finding: clears a leftover error from a previous visit's
90	    // failed toggle — this cubit is a DI singleton, so without this a
91	    // stale message would still be showing on an unrelated later visit.
92	    widget.cubit.clearStaleError();
93	    // Boundaries: "`AccountSettingsScreen.initState` calls
94	    // `dashboardCubit.load()` unconditionally... so every open is a live
95	    // fetch, never the singleton's stale state" (FR-09: "computed on
96	    // demand, never stale").
97	    widget.dashboardCubit.load();
98	    // spec-8-2 — fired alongside the call above, neither awaiting the
99	    // other (Boundaries: "two independent fetches fired in parallel").
100	    widget.narrativeCubit.load();
101	  }
102	
103	  @override
104	  void dispose() {
105	    _nameController.dispose();
106	    super.dispose();
107	  }
108	
109	  /// spec-8-3 — caller derives initials from the display name (Boundaries):
110	  /// first letter of the first word plus first letter of the last word (a
111	  /// single-word name yields one letter) — `Avatar` itself only renders
112	  /// whatever it's given, uppercased.
113	  ///
114	  /// Code-review patch: extracts each initial via `Characters.first`
115	  /// (Unicode grapheme-cluster aware), not `String.substring(0, 1)` —
116	  /// `substring` slices by UTF-16 code unit, which would split an astral-
117	  /// plane character (e.g. an emoji) that starts a word into an unpaired
118	  /// surrogate half.
119	  String _initialsFor(String name) {
120	    final words = name
121	        .trim()
122	        .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
123	        .where((w) => w.isNotEmpty)
124	        .toList();
125	    if (words.isEmpty) {
126	      return '';
127	    }
128	    final first = words.first.characters.first;
129	    if (words.length == 1) {
130	      return first;
131	    }
132	    final last = words.last.characters.first;
133	    return '$first$last';
134	  }
135	
136	  /// spec-8-3 — the profile header: 52dp avatar + name/email, the pencil-
137	  /// becomes-check inline name edit (Intent/Boundaries). Built from
138	  /// `AccountSettingsState` directly, same "cubit is the single source"
139	  /// convention the rest of this screen already follows.
140	  Widget _buildNameRow(BuildContext context, AccountSettingsState state) {
141	    final cubit = context.read<AccountSettingsCubit>();
142	    if (!state.isEditingName) {
143	      return Row(
144	        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
145	        children: [
146	          Flexible(
147	            child: Text(
148	              state.displayName,
149	              style: DesignTokens.textTitleSm.copyWith(
150	                color: DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary,
151	              ),
152	              // Code-review patch: the backend allows a displayName up to
153	              // 80 characters — without this, a long name wraps to
154	              // multiple lines inside this `Flexible`, misaligning against
155	              // the fixed-size pencil icon beside it.
156	              maxLines: 1,
157	              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
158	            ),
159	          ),
160	          const SizedBox(width: DesignTokens.spacingSm),
161	          Semantics(
162	            button: true,
163	            label: 'Editar nome',
164	            excludeSemantics: true,
165	            child: InkWell(
166	              onTap: cubit.startEditingName,
167	              child: ConstrainedBox(
168	                constraints: const BoxConstraints(
169	                  minWidth: DesignTokens.insertionModalTapTargetMin,
170	                  minHeight: DesignTokens.insertionModalTapTargetMin,
171	                ),
172	                child: const Icon(
173	                  Icons.edit,
174	                  size: DesignTokens.dialogIconSize,
175	                  color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
176	                ),
177	              ),
178	            ),
179	          ),
180	        ],
181	      );
182	    }
183	
184	    // Boundaries: "Field + check icon in one TapRegion(onTapOutside:
185	    // cancelEditingName)" — a tap anywhere outside this field+icon pair
186	    // reverts the unconfirmed edit, no PATCH sent.
187	    return TapRegion(
188	      onTapOutside: (_) => cubit.cancelEditingName(),
189	      child: Row(
190	        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
191	        children: [
192	          Expanded(
193	            child: AppTextField(
194	              controller: _nameController,
195	              errorText: state.nameErrorMessage,
196	              onChanged: cubit.updateNameDraft,
197	            ),
198	          ),
199	          const SizedBox(width: DesignTokens.spacingSm),
200	          if (state.isSavingName)
201	            const SizedBox(
202	              width: DesignTokens.accountSettingsSavingIndicatorSize,
203	              height: DesignTokens.accountSettingsSavingIndicatorSize,
204	              child: CircularProgressIndicator(
205	                strokeWidth:
206	                    DesignTokens.accountSettingsSavingIndicatorStrokeWidth,
207	                color: DesignTokens.colorAccent,
208	              ),
209	            )

211	            Semantics(
212	              button: true,
213	              label: 'Salvar nome',
214	              excludeSemantics: true,
215	              child: InkWell(
216	                onTap: cubit.confirmEditingName,
217	                child: ConstrainedBox(
218	                  constraints: const BoxConstraints(
219	                    minWidth: DesignTokens.insertionModalTapTargetMin,
220	                    minHeight: DesignTokens.insertionModalTapTargetMin,
221	                  ),
222	                  child: const Icon(
223	                    Icons.check,
224	                    size: DesignTokens.dialogIconSize,
225	                    color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
226	                  ),
227	                ),
228	              ),
229	            ),
230	        ],
231	      ),

233	  }

235	  Widget _buildProfileHeader(BuildContext context, AccountSettingsState state) {
236	    return Row(
237	      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
238	      children: [
239	        Avatar(
240	          size: AvatarSize.large,

242	        ),

269	  // Review finding: mirrors `vault_lock_screen.dart`'s own `_announce` —
270	  // VoiceOver (this app is iOS-only) doesn't reliably treat a live-region
271	  // subtree update as an announcement on its own, so a failed/reverted
272	  // toggle is spoken explicitly here instead.
273	  Future<void> _announce(String message) async {
274	    if (!mounted) {

276	    }

278	      View.of(context),

284	  @override
285	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
286	    return MultiBlocProvider(
287	      providers: [
288	        BlocProvider.value(value: widget.cubit),
289	        // spec-8-1 — makes `DashboardCubit` available to
290	        // `DashboardChartSection` below, same two-cubit convention
291	        // `MeusRegistrosScreen` already uses for its own `cubit`/
292	        // `searchCubit` pair.
293	        BlocProvider.value(value: widget.dashboardCubit),
294	        // spec-8-2 — makes `DashboardNarrativeCubit` available to
295	        // `DashboardChartSection`'s own narrative section, same
296	        // convention as `dashboardCubit` above.
297	        BlocProvider.value(value: widget.narrativeCubit),
298	      ],
299	      child: Scaffold(
300	        backgroundColor: DesignTokens.colorSurfaceBg,
301	        body: Column(
302	          children: [
303	            const BackArrowHeader(title: 'Configurações'),
304	            // spec-8-1 — now `Expanded` + scrollable: the toggle alone
305	            // always fit unscrolled, but the chart section below it can
306	            // grow past the available height on a shorter device/larger
307	            // text scale (Design Notes: "decide and proceed" — neither
308	            // `prototype-extract.md` nor the frozen spec says whether this
309	            // screen scrolls).
310	            Expanded(
311	              child: SingleChildScrollView(
312	                padding: DesignTokens.screenPadding,
313	                child: Column(
314	                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
315	                  children: [
316	                    // spec-8-3 — Code Map: "header is the first scroll-
317	                    // Column child, above the toggle".
318	                    MultiBlocListener(
319	                      listeners: [
320	                        // Syncs the field's controller only at the moment
321	                        // editing starts — while editing, the field's own
322	                        // `onChanged` (-> `updateNameDraft`) is this
323	                        // screen's single source for both the
324	                        // controller's displayed text and the cubit's own
325	                        // `nameDraft`.
326	                        BlocListener<
327	                          AccountSettingsCubit,
328	                          AccountSettingsState
329	                        >(
330	                          listenWhen: (previous, current) =>
331	                              !previous.isEditingName && current.isEditingName,
332	                          listener: (context, state) {
333	                            _nameController.text = state.nameDraft;
334	                            _nameController.selection = TextSelection.collapsed(
335	                              offset: _nameController.text.length,
336	                            );
337	                          },
338	                        ),
339	                        // Boundaries: "`_announce` fires on a save
340	                        // failure, same `BlocListener` convention as the
341	                        // toggle's error".
342	                        BlocListener<
343	                          AccountSettingsCubit,
344	                          AccountSettingsState
345	                        >(

14	/// `scrimIn` (0.18s ease-out fade) as the only entrance choreography, and
15	/// at most one instance open at a time — [show] is the one way this
16	/// widget is ever presented, and owns that single-overlay guard itself so
17	/// no caller has to re-implement it.
18	class ConfirmationDialog extends StatelessWidget {
19	  const ConfirmationDialog({
20	    super.key,
21	    required this.icon,
22	    required this.title,
23	    required this.message,
24	    required this.confirmLabel,
25	    required this.onConfirm,
26	    required this.barrierColor,
27	    this.titleColor = DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary,
28	    this.caption,
29	  });

32	  final String title;
33	  final String message;
34	  final String confirmLabel;
35	  final VoidCallback onConfirm;
36	
37	  /// The full-bleed scrim color behind the centered card — callers pass
38	  /// `DesignTokens.colorScrim` (session-expiry, Story 1.5) or the heavier
39	  /// drawer/sheet value a later story uses for its own confirmation.
40	  final Color barrierColor;

43	  /// or destructive (`colorError`, a later story's account-deletion
44	  /// confirm) — never any other color (Boundaries: "neutral
45	  /// `colorTextPrimary` title, never `colorError`" for *this* story's own
46	  /// call site).
47	  final Color titleColor;
48	
49	  /// Small mono caption below the button (Story 1.5: "o histórico e a
50	  /// posição do scroll são preservados"). Optional — a future destructive
51	  /// confirmation has no equivalent.
52	  final String? caption;
53	
54	  /// Whether an instance is currently showing — the single-overlay guard
55	  /// (UX-DR16/25/27/36: "never stacks on another open overlay"). Exposed
56	  /// for tests; callers should not need to read it directly.
57	  static bool isOpen = false;
58	
59	  /// Presents [builder]'s [ConfirmationDialog] as a non-dismissible,
60	  /// focus-trapped overlay above whatever screen is currently showing,
61	  /// without replacing it — the underlying route stays mounted, so its
62	  /// scroll/state is preserved (Boundaries: "the authenticated screen's
63	  /// widget instance is never replaced").
64	  ///
65	  /// A second call while one is already open is a silent no-op (I/O
66	  /// matrix: "already-open overlay ... no second dialog stacks").
67	  static Future<void> show({
68	    required BuildContext context,
69	    required WidgetBuilder builder,
70	  }) {
71	    if (isOpen) {
72	      return Future<void>.value();
73	    }
74	    isOpen = true;
75	    try {
76	      return showGeneralDialog<void>(
77	        context: context,
78	        barrierDismissible: false,
79	        // The framework's own `ModalBarrier` stays fully transparent — the
80	        // scrim actually seen on screen is this widget's own `build()`
81	        // below, which lets `transitionBuilder` fade the scrim and the card
82	        // together as one `scrimIn` choreography instead of two separately
83	        // animated layers.
84	        barrierColor: Colors.transparent,
85	        transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
86	        transitionBuilder: (context, animation, secondaryAnimation, child) {
87	          return FadeTransition(
88	            opacity: CurvedAnimation(parent: animation, curve: Curves.easeOut),
89	            child: child,
90	          );
91	        },
92	        pageBuilder: (context, animation, secondaryAnimation) => PopScope(
93	          // UX-DR16/25/27/36 — non-dismissible: `barrierDismissible: false`
94	          // above only stops a scrim tap; without this, the system/hardware
95	          // back gesture would still pop the route and close the overlay.
96	          canPop: false,
97	          child: builder(context),

102	      // passing a `context` with no `Navigator` ancestor) must still release
103	      // the guard — otherwise every later `show()` call, from any caller,
104	      // silently no-ops forever.

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Configurações has no way to end the session — "Sair" is a dead action (epic-8-context.md's Story 8.4 scope; FR-42, RF03).

**Approach:** Add `logout()`/`lock()`/`clearLocalCache()` to `SessionRepository`/`VaultRepository`/`EntriesRepository`/`ChatRepository` respectively; `AccountSettingsCubit` orchestrates all four behind one `logout()` call triggered by a new "Sair" button. No new navigation code — the existing `app_router.dart` redirect (already watching both streams) takes the user to Biometria once the vault relocks.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `SessionRepository.logout()` (mirrors `restoreSession()`): calls new `AuthRemoteDataSource.logout()` (`POST auth-logout`, bearerAuth, no body), then UNCONDITIONALLY calls `AccessTokenProvider.clearSession()` and emits `SessionStatus.unauthenticated` — must work even offline.
- `VaultRepository.lock()` (new, sync, mirrors `markAuthenticated()`): `_emit(VaultStatus.locked)`. Cubit calls this BEFORE awaiting `sessionRepository.logout()` — AD-14's vault-gate-first redirect then lands on `/vault` (Biometria) with no transient `/auth` hop (prototype-extract.md:40-41, Story 8.5 shares this destination).
- `EntriesRepository`/`ChatRepository` gain `clearLocalCache()` (`Either<Failure, Unit>`, `try`/`catch` around box `.clear()`) — closes deferred-work.md's "no clear-on-logout hook" gap now that a logout feature exists.
- `AccountSettingsCubit` gains the 4 repos above as constructor deps (same direct-domain-interface precedent as `EntryDetailCubit`→`SessionRepository`) + `logout()`: guard re-entry via new `isLoggingOut`, `vaultRepository.lock()`, `await sessionRepository.logout()` (result ignored — local session already ended regardless), `await Future.wait([entries.clearLocalCache(), chat.clearLocalCache()])`, same `isClosed` guard as `toggleBiometric`.
- Screen: `AppButton(secondaryOutline, 'Sair', onPressed: state.isLoggingOut ? null : cubit.logout)` as the scroll column's last child, below `DashboardChartSection`.

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** `sl.reset()`/re-running `setupCoreDependencies()` (strands `_CerneAppState`'s captured repo instances); clearing in-memory cubit/tracker state — scoped to only the two Hive boxes deferred-work.md names; an "Apagar conta" button/dialog (Story 8.5); surfacing a backend-logout-failure error.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Tap Sair | `isLoggingOut: false` | vault relocks immediately -> router redirects to `/vault`; `auth-logout` fires; local tokens + both Hive boxes clear | N/A |
| `auth-logout` backend call fails (offline/expired/...) | any | local session still clears, same redirect | `Left` swallowed, no UI message |
| Double-tap Sair | `isLoggingOut: true` | second tap no-ops (button disabled) | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

# Cerne — Prototype extract

The visual reference of the product is `cerne-prototype.html` (this folder). Open it in a browser; it needs JavaScript. This extract lists its navigable states, its visual tokens, its components and the implementation notes that come with it.

- **Frame:** 390 × 844 logical points, portrait only, 4 dp grid.
- **Language of the interface:** Portuguese. Every UI text below appears exactly as in the prototype, in quotes.
- **Precedence:** the prototype defines appearance and states. Behavior rules (triggers, timings, filters, error handling) are defined in `docs/input/requirements.md`; where the prototype's simulated behavior differs from a requirement, the requirement prevails.

---

## 1. Navigation map

The prototype has **32 navigable states**, reachable from a single state machine (a `screen` variable plus overlay flags). Not every state is a new full screen — several are **overlays** (modal, sheet, bottom sheet, dialog) shown on top of one of three base screens: **Home/Chat**, **Meus Registros** and **Configurações**. Overlays preserve the screen underneath (it stays visible, with a darkened scrim behind).

```
Splash (auto, 1.8 s)
  └─> Biometria ──tap/error──> PIN inicial / PIN após falha
  │      └─> "usar e-mail e senha" ──> Entrar / criar conta (toggle)
  │                                          └─> submit ──> Home/Chat
  └─(PIN complete, 4 digits)──> Home/Chat
  └─(Face ID/Touch ID ok)──> Home/Chat

Home/Chat (base screen)
  ├─ overlay: Sessão expirada (backend session expires; "Entrar novamente" ──> Biometria)
  ├─ overlay: side menu (☰ icon) ──> Meus Registros | Planos de Ação | Configurações | new conversation
  └─ overlay: Insertion modal ("+" button) ──> tabs Texto / Áudio / Foto, each with its own sub-states
        (on save, the modal closes and returns to Home/Chat with the record added)

Meus Registros (base screen, from the side menu)
  ├─ empty state (no records) ──CTA "Criar primeiro registro"──> Insertion modal
  ├─ overlay: filter sheet ──"Aplicar"──> active filters (chips on the list)
  └─ overlay: export card (download icon) ──> pending ──> processing ──> done | error | empty period

Planos de Ação (base screen, from the side menu) — static screen, 3-column kanban (extension, not implemented)

Configurações (base screen, from the side menu)
  ├─ dashboard variations: zero entries | one entry | more than 30 (with narrative) | narrative unavailable
  ├─ inline profile-name editing
  ├─ AI persona selection (Analítico / Empático / Socrático) (extension, not implemented)
  ├─ "Sair" ──> Biometria
  └─ overlay: account-deletion confirmation ──"Apagar tudo"──> Biometria (same destination as logout)
```

---

Names as they appear in the prototype. ## 5. Implementation notes

1. **"29 frames" vs. "32 states":** the prototype has 32 distinct navigable states, but the number of frames (29) suggests that some state families should be one screen with internal state, not separate routes (e.g., a single `ExportSheet` with a status enum instead of 5 routes). Consider this when designing navigation.
2. **Account deletion without a success screen:** both "Sair" and "Apagar tudo" return to the Biometria screen; there is no "account deleted" or "you signed out" screen.
3. **Login vs. sign-up:** the same screen toggled by a text link; the prototype shows no extra sign-up fields (e.g., password confirmation, name). Whether sign-up needs extra fields is a product decision not covered visually.
4. **Insertion modal when offline:** not represented.
5. **Switching tabs in the insertion modal:** opening the modal always resets every tab to `idle`/empty, but switching tabs *during* a modal session is not cleared automatically — the expected behavior (e.g., whether an ongoing recording is discarded on tab switch) is not defined by the prototype.

message.content:
The coordinator sent a message while you were working:
Code review of your spec-8-5-account-deletion.md implementation found two real, trivially-fixable bugs. Please apply both patches now, then re-run `fvm flutter analyze` and `fvm flutter test test/core/widgets test/features/account test/core/navigation`, and confirm both are clean.

1. `lib/features/account/presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit.dart` — `deleteAccount()` has no `try`/`finally` around its own async work, unlike `logout()` (which you correctly wrapped). If `await _repository.deleteAccount()` ever throws instead of resolving to an `Either` (or if anything between the emit and the final state-settle throws), `isDeletingAccount` stays `true` forever, permanently disabling the "Apagar conta" button — this is the exact bug class the existing `logout()`/`finally` guard already protects against (see the comment there: "guarantees `isLoggingOut` resets even if an unexpected throw escapes the chain above"). Fix: restructure `deleteAccount()` so the entire body from the initial `emit(isDeletingAccount: true, ...)` through to completion is covered by a `try`/`finally` that unconditionally resets `isDeletingAccount` to `false` (respecting the existing `isClosed` guards and the fact that the failure branch already sets its own `deleteAccountErrorMessage`, and the success branch already runs `_finishSession()` — the `finally` should not clobber a `deleteAccountErrorMessage` that the failure branch just set, and should not fire if the success branch's own inner `try/finally` around `_finishSession()` already reset the flag). The cleanest shape: wrap the whole method body in one outer `try { ... } finally { if (!isClosed) emit(state.copyWith(isDeletingAccount: false)); }`, and remove the now-redundant inner emits of `isDeletingAccount: false` from the two branches (keep the inner `try/finally` around `_finishSession()` only for its own unrelated-throw safety, or simplify if the outer finally already covers it — your judgment on the minimal clean shape, as long as the end state is: any throw, anywhere in this method, still leaves `isDeletingAccount: false`).

2. `lib/core/widgets/confirmation_dialog.dart` — `ConfirmationDialog`'s `cancelLabel`/`onCancel` constructor params have no `assert` enforcing they're supplied together (currently the `_Card` only renders the cancel button when `cancelLabel != null && onCancel != null`, so a future caller passing only one silently loses the cancel button instead of failing loudly). Add `assert((cancelLabel == null) == (onCancel == null), 'cancelLabel and onCancel must be supplied together')` to the `ConfirmationDialog` constructor.

After both are fixed and verification passes, update `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-8-5-account-deletion.md`'s Tasks & Acceptance / status is already handled by me — you don't need to touch the spec file's frontmatter or task checkboxes, just report back what you changed in the two Dart files and the verification output.

Address this before completing your current task.

input.message:
Applied both review patches.

1. `lib/features/account/presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit.dart` — `deleteAccount()` restructured: the entire body (from the initial `emit(isDeletingAccount: true, ...)` through the repository call and `result.match`) is now wrapped in one outer `try { ... } finally { if (!isClosed) emit(state.copyWith(isDeletingAccount: false)); }`, mirroring `logout()`'s existing guard. Removed the now-redundant inner `isDeletingAccount: false` emits from both branches: the failure branch now only sets `deleteAccountErrorMessage` (the outer `finally`'s later emit doesn't pass `deleteAccountErrorMessage`, so `copyWith` leaves it untouched); the success branch now just returns `_finishSession()` directly (no more inner try/finally, since the outer one already covers any throw). End result: any throw anywhere in `deleteAccount()` — including `_repository.deleteAccount()` itself throwing instead of resolving to an `Either` — still leaves `isDeletingAccount: false`.

2. `lib/core/widgets/confirmation_dialog.dart` — added `assert((cancelLabel == null) == (onCancel == null), 'cancelLabel and onCancel must be supplied together')` to `ConfirmationDialog`'s constructor, so a future caller supplying only one of the pair fails loudly instead of silently losing the cancel button.

Verification:
- `fvm flutter analyze` — 0 issues.
- `fvm flutter test test/core/widgets test/features/account test/core/navigation` — 194/194 pass.

Both clean. No other files touched (per your note, left the spec file's frontmatter/checkboxes alone).
